concept: The Shopping Issue, redesigned after feedback L029: a magazine reel where every spread has its own composition and its own device, so no two animations repeat and nothing overlaps.

dimensions.palette: pure black, white and one pale hairline grey (Bombay Bride Edition 6)
dimensions.fonts: Bodoni Moda display with italic, Jost capitals for labels
dimensions.opening: a thread draws through seven drawn islands and joins them under the first line
dimensions.transition: mixed: continuous map glide inside Colaba, paper slide with hard edge, paper tear, shutter iris
dimensions.camera: map descent from city to island, then straight-on printed pages
dimensions.layout: magazine spreads, each a different composition: number-first, off-centre strip, centred monument, left column plus strip, plate
dimensions.texture: halftone only on the cover and Bandra; clean grain photographs elsewhere; torn paper edges
dimensions.sound: foley only: paper, press, chisel, tram rail, projector, rubber stamp
dimensions.ending: stamp the passport: the Bb inside a round stamp

experiment.move: one device per spread, transitions that differ
experiment.hypothesis: If no device appears twice and a script checks text overlap, the viewer stops reading the spreads as one template.
